title: Vib Apps Engine Configuration (app.config.json)
description: Frozen v1 schema for .vibtools/apps/app.config.json powering apps.vib.tools and get.vib.tools.

slug.description: Unique lowercase URL slug used on apps.vib.tools/app/<slug> and get.vib.tools/<slug>.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the application.

tagline.description: Concise one-line description shown on catalog cards and the app detail header.

category.description: Marketplace category label (e.g. Productivity, Developer Tools, Utilities).

access.description: Access or origin tier badge: Free (first-party free/OSS), Paid (first-party commercial), or Forge (curated third-party or reverse-engineered utility).

icon.description: Direct HTTPS URL to the application icon image (PNG/SVG/WebP).

latest.description: Default release version key. Must match an exact key inside versions.

installer.description: Default installer script for all versions unless overridden per version.

docs.description: Repository-relative paths to Markdown documentation tabs rendered on apps.vib.tools.

features.description: Safe repo-relative path to overview/features Markdown (defaults to .vibtools/apps/features.md).

changelog.description: Safe repo-relative path to release changelog Markdown (defaults to .vibtools/apps/changelog.md).

platforms.description: Supported operating systems displayed in the app metadata panel.

requirements.description: Optional system requirements list or key-value map.

screenshots.description: Optional HTTPS screenshot URLs or objects with alt text.

dependencies.description: Optional companion tools or third-party runtimes required when installing manually via archive/ZIP. Renders the conditional Companion Tools card on apps.vib.tools.

links.description: Optional external HTTPS resource links (e.g. docs, homepage, source, license).

versions.description: Map of version identifiers (e.g. v1.0.3) to release artifacts and optional per-version installers.

installerSpec.description: Repo-relative script path (e.g. .vibtools/apps/installer.ps1), trusted HTTPS script URL, or typed installer object.

type.description: Shell runtime label for the installer.

script.description: Repo-relative path to the script (e.g. .vibtools/apps/installer.ps1) or trusted HTTPS URL.

url.description: Direct HTTPS binary download URL on a trusted host (dl.vib.tools, github.com, or configured allowlist).

installer.description: Optional per-version installer override (repo path or trusted HTTPS URL). Inherits root installer when omitted.

sha256.description: 64-character hexadecimal SHA256 checksum for integrity verification.

released_at.description: UTC release date in strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

deprecated.description: Marks an older release as deprecated in version selectors.

name.description: Display name of the companion tool or runtime (e.g. Chromium, FFmpeg, VC++ Redistributable).

url.description: Direct HTTPS download URL or official vendor download page (strict https:// without credentials).

version.description: Optional recommended or minimum version label (e.g. 131.0, 6.1+).

note.description: Optional concise one-line note explaining why the tool is needed.

required.description: Indicates whether the companion tool is mandatory (true) or optional (false).
